title: ZR section 23-421 (pitched-roof envelope) names R1/R2 only as bare group labels - whether they sweep in the lettered variants R1-2A/R2A/R2X, and whether higher-density R2X shares the 25/35 ft envelope, is a legal-interpretation question no captured official text resolves; M4-T012 (A1 wave 1, R1+R2 families) is blocked on a qualified-human ruling (Section 20 / Tier D)
affects: M4-T012 (D-045-R001 A1 wave 1: R1+R2 series height/setback families) - producer reported BLOCKED with zero files written (fail-closed held; nothing guessed)
D-045 campaign sequencing - the A1 wave re-points to the explicitly-enumerated R3/R4 families (M4-T014) while this ruling is pending
detail: Producer (rules-engineer) verified the current-effective City of Yes text (Last Amended 2024-12-05) live against zr.planning.nyc.gov on 2026-09-13 (sections 23-42, 23-421, 23-422, 23-44/441/442, 21-11) and cross-checked the byte-verified in-corpus zr-23-21 FAR snapshot (digest b52771e6...). Findings: (1) section 23-421 applies to 'R1 R2 R3A R3X R3-1 R3-2 R4 R4-1 R4A R5A' - the R3/R4 variants are enumerated EXPLICITLY while R1/R2 appear only as group labels; R1-1/R1-2/R1-2A/R2A/R2X appear in NO captured governing height/setback section; (2) the zr-23-21 FAR table treats R2X differently from R2/R2A (grouped with R4 at FAR 1.00 vs 0.75), so assuming R2X shares the 25/35 pitched envelope would be a guess; (3) section 23-422 (flat alternative) EXCLUDES R1/R2; (4) the packet premise ('numeric limits, no A2 dependency') is contradicted - R1/R2 setback is sloping-plane geometry (A2, deferred by D-045-R008), only the 25 ft perimeter-wall / 35 ft ridge caps are numeric. Producer wrote no ruleset/snapshot rather than transcribe or infer (permanent principle 3); worktree left clean; source facts preserved in .claude/agent-memory/rules-engineer/zr-r1-r2-height-setback-source-facts.md.
needs: OWNER / QUALIFIED-HUMAN RULING (G6-adjacent; Section 20 hard stop - never an agent interpretation): (a) do section 23-421's bare 'R1'/'R2' group labels include the lettered variants R1-1, R1-2, R1-2A, R2A, R2X? (b) does R2X share the 25/35 ft pitched envelope or carry a distinct one? (c) confirm no other section assigns R2A/R2X/R1-2A a distinct height/setback envelope. On the ruling, M4-T012 re-dispatches (encode per the ruling, with sloping-plane setback mechanics still recorded as typed A2 gaps); until then it stays blocked and MUST NOT resume while M4-T014 (R3/R4, same directory scopes) is in flight (D-046-R002).
